items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I took his place in the band. So anyway, I joined Duke

ctx.x: So I played my first show at the Apollo around the month of January of 1939.

I think right here we ought to say in the tape who Tom Whaley is; he was one of the great writers and copyists and accompanists and arrangers, extracting all the scores of Duke Ellington, down through the years and was Duke's best friend until he died. And one of the saddest things -- I don't know if you ever knew this, but one of the saddest things was that Tom knew exactly how Duke wrote -- any little scrap of newspaper, or any scrap of paper that Duke put anything down on, Tom would know just how to…

items.title: Panama Francis interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 1, 1995
items.q: I mean Duke Ellington and Count Basie and Roy Eldridge and these people, they’ll tell you right off hand, I play music.

ctx.x: When music is played for dancing, the rhythm in the music itself has to speak to the dancers, doesn’t it?

Yeah. Well see I mean my conception, and I was the youngest one in all the bands I worked in, so I never was a teenager. I spent all my time with older musicians, I mean all my time was spent with older musicians. So I got many a stories and I heard of many a stories and like I mean I used to hang out with Eubie Blake you know. I mean Eubie Blake was old enough to be my grandfather, I mean great grandfather. But that’s who I hung out with. And right now, even now, I mean I meet people that’s my age group, and I…

musicians did. And I mean even today, like the older musicians I know, it was an insult to call them a jazz musician. I mean Duke Ellington and Count Basie and Roy Eldridge and these people, they’ll tell you right off hand, I play music. Don’t label me no jazz musician, ‘cause I can, where I mean with me I have played Bar Mitzvahs, I’ve played Polkas, I’ve played Waltzes, I’ve played Tangos, I mean you name it, I’m prostituted, long as you gonna pay me I’ll play. So I mean don’t label me a jazz musician. I’m a…
